cloudrun_hour.basis: 1 vCPU and 2 GiB active reference rate; upper adds 80% region/SKU/variance allowance; not a current region-specific quote.

ecs_hour.basis: 1 vCPU and 2 GiB US East Linux x86 example, 1–2x regional planning allowance; load balancer/network charged separately.

appservice_hour.basis: Authored broad SKU/region planning envelope; exact App Service SKU not quoted by this model.

ec2_hour.basis: Authored VM planning envelope; exact SKU, reserved pricing and license not selected.

local_hour.basis: Authored incremental electricity/storage operating allowance on already-owned hardware; not an AWS/local tariff quote. Hardware purchase and labor excluded.

database_cpu_hour.basis: Cloud SQL reference CPU with up to 2x geography/SKU allowance; other providers use this declared proxy pending exact quotes.

database_memory_gb_hour.basis: Cloud SQL memory reference; a declared proxy for other managed providers, not their quoted rate.

database_storage_gb.basis: Authored regional persistent-storage envelope, including replica copies explicitly in quantity.

object_storage_gb.basis: Authored standard-storage envelope; requests/lifecycle operations have a separate allowance.

egress_gb.basis: Authored internet-egress envelope; actual destination, free quota and routes vary.

backup_gb.basis: Authored backup-storage envelope with retained copy quantity; no cross-region copy assumed.

otp_message.basis: Assumed USD/SMS planning envelope only; verify country, tax, DLT and provider quote. No currency conversion or MSG91 tariff is claimed.

payment_fraction.basis: Assumed fee fraction, not quoted pricing; merchant country, card mix and extras vary.

payment_fixed.basis: Assumed per-transaction USD fee envelope, not a tariff quote.

ase_i1v2_hour.basis: Central India primary Linux I1 v2 consumption meter at USD 0.395/instance-hour, reviewed 13 November 2026. Whole 2-vCPU instances, no discounts/tax/dedicated host; autoscaling and quota require review.

razorpay_fraction.basis: Illustrative 2–3% platform-fee scenario from the domestic pricing starting point; not a merchant quote. GST, premium methods, payouts and FX are excluded; no INR/USD conversion is inferred.

razorpay_fixed.basis: No separate fixed per-transaction fee modeled for standard domestic checkout; other merchant/product/settlement fees require a quote and are excluded, not assumed universally free.

lightsail_bundle_month.basis: Linux IPv4 general-purpose 4 GiB/2 vCPU/80 GB SSD bundle, full month USD 24. No promotion or reserved discount; burstable performance requires measurement.

lightsail_snapshot_gb.basis: Published snapshot storage USD 0.05/GB-month. Application-consistent database backups require explicit recovery tests.

lightsail_disk_gb.basis: Published additional SSD block disk USD 0.10/allocated GB-month, minimum 8 GB. OS/root SSD allowance is accounted separately.

cloudrun_instance_hour.basis: Iowa on-demand instance-based reference: (USD 0.000018/vCPU-second + 2 GiB × USD 0.000002/GiB-second) × 3600 = USD 0.0792/hour. Upper is an authored 80% geography/SKU allowance, not a regional quote; no free tier or commitment discount applied.
